issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: oqoqo
products.tagline: Build evals and custom benchmarks for real-world tasks
products.summaryZh: 为真实世界任务构建评估与自定义基准。
products.descriptionZh: 在真实环境中大规模运行评估实验。定义自定义任务集以构建私有基准，衡量智能体使用任意产品的能力，并找到最适合您用例的模型。生成动态洞察，以检测产品界面中的摩擦或令牌低效问题。
products.description: Run eval experiments at scale in realistic environments. Define custom task sets to build your private benchmarks, measure how well agents can use any product, and find best models for your use cases. Generate dynamic insights to detect frictions in product interfaces or token inefficiencies.

products.name: Portfolio Lab
products.tagline: AI investing, done responsibly
products.summaryZh: AI投资，责任先行。
products.descriptionZh: AI让构建投资策略变得简单，但区分好策略与幸运策略仍需专业知识。Portfolio Lab是一个负责任的AI投资平台：每个策略都在未见数据和实盘市场中经过测试。连接你的智能体，仅在你的券商账户中部署经过验证的策略。已在美国证券交易委员会注册。
products.description: AI made building investment strategies easy. Telling a good one from a lucky one still takes expertise. Portfolio Lab is the responsible AI investing platform: every strategy is tested on unseen data and in live markets. Connect your agent to deploy only vetted strategies in your own brokerage account. SEC-registered.

products.name: Paritok
products.tagline: Spend up to 85% less and run 3× longer coding agent sessions
products.summaryZh: 最高节省85%成本，编码代理会话运行时长延长3倍
products.descriptionZh: Paritok压缩你的编码代理发送的工具、文件和历史记录。节省高达85%的令牌费用，并运行3倍更长的会话。两个命令，无任何丢失，完全本地化。
products.description: Paritok compresses the tools, files, and history your coding agent sends. Save up to 85% on your token bill and run 3× longer sessions. Two commands, nothing lost, fully local.

products.name: SecondBrain Note by GenSpark
products.tagline: A MagSafe AI Recorder That Acts for You
products.summaryZh: 一款为你代劳的MagSafe AI录音器
products.descriptionZh: 卡片般纤薄的AI录音笔。一键按下，每次会议自动转化为笔记，直接存入你的第二大脑。你只需聆听。随身相伴——厚度仅2.95毫米，重量26克，轻松滑入卡包或贴附于手机。不错过任何一句话——拾音范围超过5米，可连续录音长达35小时。你的对话始终属于你——企业级安全防护，通过SOC 2 Type II及ISO 27001认证。
products.description: A card-thin AI voice recorder. Press once, and every meeting turns itself into notes, saved straight into your SecondBrain. You just listen. Always with you — just 2.95 mm thin and 26 g light, it slips into your card holder and onto your phone. Never miss a word — it picks up voices from over 5 meters away and records up to 35 hours. Your conversations stay yours — enterprise-grade security, certified SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001.

products.name: AI Group Call
products.tagline: Type a goal, join a live voice call with six AI minds
products.summaryZh: 输入一个目标，与六个AI头脑进行实时语音通话。
products.descriptionZh: 设定一个目标，几秒钟内你就能与六位AI参与者进行实时语音通话。他们逐一回答，相互辩论，并在你开口的瞬间停止。每次通话都会被记录，总结为关键点和行动项，之后可随时以相同阵容重新加入。每个新账户免费赠送一分钟，无需绑定银行卡。
products.description: State a goal and you are in a live voice call with six AI participants cast for it in seconds. They answer one at a time, argue with each other, and stop the instant you speak. Every call is transcribed, summarised into key points and action items, and can be rejoined later with the same cast. A free minute on every new account, no card.

products.name: Prime Agent
products.tagline: A coding agent that can refine its own harness
products.summaryZh: 能够自我优化测试框架的编码代理
products.descriptionZh: Prime Agent是一个开源的、自我改进的编码框架，围绕两个抽象构建：递归语言模型（RLM）和持续框架。借助Opus 5，它在ARC-AGI-3上达到95.5%的准确率，超越了报告的人类专家基线。
products.description: Prime Agent is an open-source, self-improving coding harness built around two abstractions: the Recursive Language Model (RLM) and the Continual Harness. With Opus 5, it achieves 95.5% on ARC-AGI-3, surpassing the reported human expert baseline.

products.name: Gutta
products.tagline: A tiny, offline task list for your Mac menu bar
products.summaryZh: 一个极简、离线的任务清单，驻留在你的Mac菜单栏中。
products.descriptionZh: Gutta是一款专为Mac菜单栏设计的极简键盘优先任务清单。按下⌘⇧Space，以自然语言输入任务，即可迅速回归工作。它能理解自然日期和时间，将分号分隔的输入转化为多个任务，并安排本地提醒。所有数据均存储于您的Mac上，可通过您控制的文件夹（如iCloud Drive、Dropbox或OneDrive）进行可选同步——无需Gutta账户、订阅、追踪或开发者拥有的云服务。
products.description: Gutta is a tiny, keyboard-first task list for the Mac menu bar. Press ⌘⇧Space, type tasks the way you say them, and get back to work. It understands natural dates and times, turns semicolon-separated input into multiple tasks, and schedules local reminders. Everything is stored on your Mac, with optional sync through a folder you control in iCloud Drive, Dropbox, or OneDrive—no Gutta account, subscription, tracking, or developer-owned cloud.

products.name: Remix
products.tagline: Figma, but on your production app. Test variants and ship.
products.summaryZh: Figma，但用于你的生产应用。测试变体并发布。
products.descriptionZh: 你的整个团队，在真实产品上进行实验。Remix 让任何团队成员都能创建实际产品的一个变体：一个通过提示词塑造的安全、沙盒化副本。无需设置，对生产环境零风险。团队可以并排探索各种想法。如果两个变体的方向不错？将一个拖入另一个即可合并。当某个想法成熟时，直接向 GitHub 发起 PR。每个提示词都有记录，因此审查者能清楚看到它是如何构建的，而实时链接让任何人在代码合并到主分支之前就能进行测试。
products.description: Your whole team, experimenting on the real product. Remix lets any team member spin up a variant of your actual product: a safe, sandboxed copy you shape by prompting. No setup, no risk to production. Explore ideas side by side as a team. Like where two variants are headed? Drag one into the other to merge them. When an idea is ready, open a PR straight to GitHub. Every prompt is recorded, so reviewers see exactly how it was built and a live link lets anyone test before a single line hits main.

products.name: Vidaya
products.tagline: Healthspan score from your wearables, labs, and DNA.
products.summaryZh: 来自你的可穿戴设备、实验室检测和DNA的健康寿命评分。
products.descriptionZh: Vidaya将你的可穿戴设备数据、实验室检测结果和生活习惯转化为真实的健康寿命评分及个性化长寿计划。由厌倦了只显示数字却从不告诉你下一步该做什么的仪表盘的创始人打造。
products.description: Vidaya turns your wearable data, labs, and habits into a real Healthspan score and a personalized longevity plan. Built by founders tired of dashboards that show numbers but never tell you what to actually do next.

products.name: Salesman AI
products.tagline: The AI sales agent that turns meetings into revenue
products.summaryZh: 将会议转化为收入的AI销售代理
products.descriptionZh: Salesman AI在每次会议前整合买家与交易背景，将其转化为适应性演练，并将每次对话转化为交易洞察与后续行动。同一背景信息通过AI助手和交易仪表板持续可用，帮助客户经理推动会议向可衡量的管道进展迈进。
products.description: Salesman AI compiles buyer and deal context before every meeting, turns it into an adaptive rehearsal and converts each conversation into deal intelligence and next actions. The same context remains available through AI Helper and the deal dashboard, helping AEs move meetings toward measurable pipeline progress.

products.name: Heym
products.tagline: Build agentic systems. Run them with confidence
products.summaryZh: 构建智能体系统。自信地运行它们。
products.descriptionZh: Heym是一个源代码可用的平台，用于在自有基础设施上构建和运行代理系统。通过可视化方式构建多代理工作流，连接数据和工具，集成Codex和OpenCode等编码代理，并在关键环节加入人工审批。内置追踪、成本、延迟和评估功能，精确查看每次运行的性能。可自托管Heym，使用自有模型和凭据，并将工作流发布为门户、API或MCP工具。
products.description: Heym is a source-available platform for building and running agentic systems on your own infrastructure. Build multi-agent workflows visually, connect your data and tools, bring in coding agents like Codex and OpenCode, and add human approval where it matters. See exactly how every run performs with built-in traces, costs, latency, and evals. Self-host Heym, use your own models and credentials, and ship workflows as portals, APIs, or MCP tools.

products.name: dolv
products.tagline: Your AI operator for content, CRM, and GTM execution
products.summaryZh: 你的AI运营助手，用于内容、CRM及GTM执行。
products.descriptionZh: 增长团队在CRM、分析、邮件、广告和内容工具之间切换工作，耗费大量时间。dolv将这些整合到一个工作空间中。给它一个任务：它会读取你的实时漏斗，在已连接的工具中执行工作，并报告已完成的内容。邮件、帖子和广告变更在发布前需等待你的批准。决策权在你手中，dolv负责执行。
products.description: Growth teams lose hours moving work between CRM, analytics, email, ads, and content tools. dolv brings that into one workspace. Give it a task: it reads your live funnel, does the work across your connected tools, and reports what shipped. Emails, posts, and ad changes wait for your approval before they go out. You keep the decisions. dolv handles the execution.

products.name: Supamodel
products.tagline: AI Product Photos at scale for Shopify
products.summaryZh: 为Shopify提供规模化AI产品照片
products.descriptionZh: 在Shopify内使用可复用的预设、工作流程、产品引用及受支持的3D素材，创建一致且可直接用于商业的产品图片集。
products.description: Create consistent, commerce-ready product image sets inside Shopify using reusable presets, workflows, product references, and supported 3D assets.

products.name: OutageDeck
products.tagline: One status page for every service your stack depends on
products.summaryZh: 一个状态页面，涵盖你的技术栈所依赖的所有服务。
products.descriptionZh: OutageDeck 从官方源追踪 172 家云和 SaaS 供应商，提供警报、历史记录、免费 JSON API 以及可供代理查询的 MCP 服务器。付费账户可添加私有 Statuspage 或 Instatus 提供商，包括其自有产品：不依赖众包或爬取。
products.description: OutageDeck tracks 172 cloud and SaaS vendors from official feeds, with alerts, history, a free JSON API, and an MCP server your agents can query. Paid accounts can add private Statuspage or Instatus providers, including their own products: no crowdsourcing or scraping.

products.name: AFK
products.tagline: Command center for teams running coding agents
products.summaryZh: 面向运行编码代理的团队指挥中心
products.descriptionZh: 编码代理工具假设的是单人开发者。对于团队而言，这种假设会失效。AFK 是面向编码代理团队的浏览器指挥中心。守护进程可运行在你的机器或公司服务器上。启动会话、审批工具、交接工作。持久会话、权限模式、计划审查、团队组织/角色、仪表盘、交接、BYOK（17 家提供商，无加价）、Docker、带 P2P 网格的子代理、MCP/技能/插件、自动化、企业部署。免费层级。60 天试用。30 天内注册超 1000 人。家庭实验室，零消耗。
products.description: Coding agent tools assume solo devs. For teams, that breaks. AFK is a browser command center for coding agent teams. Daemon on your machine or company server. Spawn sessions, approve tools, hand off work. Persistent sessions, permission modes, plan review, team orgs/roles, dashboards, handoff, BYOK (17 providers, no markup), Docker, sub-agents with P2P mesh, MCP/skills/plugins, automations, enterprise deploy. Free tier. 60-day trial. 1000+ signups in <30 days. Homelab, zero burn.

products.name: t0md
products.tagline: Convert Anything to Markdown
products.summaryZh: 将任何内容转换为Markdown
products.descriptionZh: 免费的PDF、Word、PowerPoint、HTML和JSON转Markdown转换器。拖入文档，几秒内获得干净的Markdown。无需注册。内置MCP服务器，支持Claude Code、Cursor、Grok及其他AI代理。
products.description: Free PDF, Word, PowerPoint, HTML and JSON to Markdown converter. Drop a document, get clean Markdown in seconds. No sign-up. MCP server included for Claude Code, Cursor, Grok and other AI agents.

products.name: Account Moodboard
products.tagline: Visualize Instagram & TikTok accounts' vibe & stats
products.summaryZh: 可视化Instagram与TikTok账号的氛围与数据。
products.descriptionZh: 在一个看板中查看任意Instagram或TikTok账号的视觉风格、吸引点及表现。粘贴账号名称，几秒内即可免费获取你的情绪板。
products.description: See any Instagram or TikTok account's visual mood, hooks, and performance in one board. Paste a handle, get your free moodboard in seconds.

products.name: VICE Platform - Private Beta
products.tagline: Security scans for people who ship fast
products.summaryZh: 为快速交付团队打造的安全扫描方案
products.descriptionZh: VICE以攻击者的视角审计你的Web应用：检查包中泄露的密钥、Supabase RLS配置错误、暴露的API、薄弱的响应头及基础设施……该引擎目前开源且免费，提供CLI或GitHub Action两种形式。托管平台则增加了完整闭环：验证你的域名，运行全面审计，获取带证据的发现结果，应用建议修复，再重新测试以确认问题已解决。平台以私有测试版形式开放，首批提供10个创始名额。专为快速上线的独立开发者打造。
products.description: VICE audits your web app the way an attacker would: leaked secrets in your bundles, Supabase RLS misconfigurations, exposed APIs, weak headers and infrastructure.... The engine is open source and free today, as a CLI or a GitHub Action. The hosted Platform adds the full loop: verify your domain, run a full audit, get findings with evidence, apply a suggested fix, then retest to confirm it's gone. It opens as a private beta with 10 founding spots. Built for indie builders who ship fast.

products.name: PostSnag
products.tagline: Find What's Viral On Facebook And Build Your Swipe File
products.summaryZh: 发现Facebook上的热门内容，建立你的素材库
products.descriptionZh: 即刻发现Facebook上的热门内容！无论是主页、群组、帖子、Reels还是更多，都能轻松获取。滚动浏览时，PostSnag自动捕捉帖子，并按点赞、评论、分享和视频播放量进行排名，在实时发现流中突出显示爆款内容，还能将干净的帖子数据直接导出至Claude、ChatGPT、Perplexity等平台。连接我们的MCP，即可将PostSnag自动添加到您喜爱的人工智能平台。
products.description: Find what's Viral on Facebook Right Now! Any Profiles, Facebook Groups, Posts, Reels & more! Sort, Capture, organize, and analyze winning Facebook posts. PostSnag captures posts as you scroll, ranks them by likes, comments, shares, and video plays, surfaces viral outliers in a live Discovery feed, and exports clean post data straight into Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity & More. Connect our MCP to automatically add PostSnag to your favorite Ai Platform.

products.name: Ventilate · At the right time
products.tagline: Beat the heatwave: when to open, close, and use a fan
products.summaryZh: 战胜热浪：何时开窗、关窗及使用风扇
products.descriptionZh: Ventilate 帮助你在热浪中保持凉爽，提供冷静、实用的指导。只需设置一次窗户，输入室内温度（温度计有帮助但非必需），即可获得清晰建议：何时关窗以阻挡热量，何时开窗引入新鲜空气，以及如何放置风扇让凉风抵达你身边。它利用当地天气和窗户朝向，为每扇窗提供个性化建议，并附有温和提醒和高温应对工具包。
products.description: Ventilate helps you stay cool during heatwaves with calm, practical guidance. Set up your windows once, add your indoor temperature (a thermometer helps but is not required), and get clear advice on when to close windows to keep heat out, when to open for fresh air, and where to place a fan so cool air reaches you. Uses local weather and your window directions for per-window recommendations, plus gentle reminders and a heat toolkit.
